name: Trade-off matrix
author: Built-in
md:
# Choosing a queue
| | SQS | Kafka | Postgres |
|---|---|---|---|
| Ops | **None** | High | None |
| Ordering | FIFO opt. | **Per partition** | Per row |
| Throughput | High | **Very high** | Medium |
| Replay | No | **Yes** | Manual |
> [!TIP] Start with Postgres; move to Kafka past 5k jobs/s.

name: On-call runbook
author: Built-in
md:

:::list style=number

- Open Grafana → API errors by route
- Scale API to 2× if CPU > 80%
- Page DB on-call if pool > 90%
:::
> [!NOTE] Post in #incidents within 5 minutes.
